scope: EMBER Research Engine; independent crypto strategy discovery; no exchange orders
primary_objective: Evidence for positive net expectation under realistic expenses with bounded portfolio drawdown and unattended operability
hard_research_gates: Original source and data SHA provenance or explicitly labelled independent causal replay
Causal timestamps: indicators only after source candles close; simulate entry strictly after signal known
Complete fills/positions/funding/fees/slippage and worst-case no-fill/gap documented; fail closed on missing data
Chronological preregistration before scoring; no hyperopt on claimed test windows
Reference baseline at comparable capital at risk; cash, spot buy-and-hold and applicable simple-rule benchmark
Risk measured at portfolio level when aggregate portfolio claimed; no arithmetic sum of separate wallets mislabelled as portfolio
Several non-overlapping market regimes and independent forward/PAPER; enumerate prior tests and multiple comparisons
Safety check: stop, liquidation, collateral, min notional, API error, delayed data and unattended state management
No live order or current PAPER scheduler modification without separate explicit request
not_hard_constraints: Target X percent return by date Y
Compulsory 4h price zone in every strategy

examples: trending vs ranging vs hold cash

decision_rules: NEVER infer profitable from successful CI or from original author's README
NO fixed trade count per day veto; insufficient sample size leads INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, not manufactured trades
Do not claim PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH_EDGE unless source, expenses, benchmark and chrono data are verified and no disqualifying execution defect exists
Do not claim FORWARD_PAPER_VALIDATED from backtest data, even if several years
PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH_EDGE not equivalent to trading approval
Carry cannot claim net returns from funding-only series absent spot/perp basis and hedge-leg costs
Do not optimize on already used 2024/2025/2026 windows and call them unseen
Maximize risk-adjusted robustness, not raw CAGR from extreme leverage

research_test_horizon.next_unseen_test: future chronological forward PAPER or otherwise verifiably untouched market data
